raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner contradicted itself by noting a same-mass, same-size Moon would create larger tidal forces but then concluded “minor” (smaller) tides, finalizing “B) There would be minor tides on Earth.” Stronger lunar gravity would produce bigger tides, so the correct outcome is “B) There would be bigger tides on Earth.” This incorrect conclusion occurred in the first (and only) Planner step.
